title: testing/synctest
short_description: A virtual clock for your tests, so a five second timeout takes no time at all.
summary: Concurrent code is hard to test for a boring reason: the interesting behaviour happens after a delay, and tests cannot afford to wait. So we sprinkle `time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)` and hope. `testing/synctest` runs your goroutines in a bubble with a fake clock that only moves when everything is blocked, which makes a five second timeout finish instantly and makes the flakiness go away.
diagram_caption: Inside a bubble the clock is a value, not a wall. It only advances when every goroutine is durably blocked, so waiting costs nothing.
